meta.name: arbor
meta.description: Autonomously improve a real artifact (code, training recipe, agent harness, data pipeline, prompt) against an objective and an evaluator, using Hypothesis Tree Refinement (HTR) from the Arbor paper. Use this whenever someone wants to iteratively optimize something over many experiments without overfitting — e.g. "get my model's eval score up", "improve this agent/harness", "tune this pipeline", "beat the baseline on this benchmark", "run a search over approaches and keep the best", "do an MLE-bench / Kaggle-style optimization", or any long-horizon "make this artifact better and don't just memorize the dev set" task. Trigger it even when the user doesn't say "Arbor" or "hypothesis tree" but describes repeated experiment-and-evaluate loops, branching exploration of competing ideas, or worries about a dev/test gap. Runs Claude itself as the coordinator with subagent executors in isolated git worktrees; for the standalone `arbor` CLI tool see references/arbor-upstream.md.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用自动实验把模型或流程的评分逐步顶高
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常为模型或流程的分数头疼,想用自动实验挑出更稳妥的方案
copy.tagline_en: Run experiments to push model or pipeline scores steadily higher
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automatic experiments to improve a model or pipeline and avoid overfitting.

howto.what: Claude 会围绕一个目标和评测器自主优化你现有的产物（代码、训练配方、提示词等）：反复提出假设、派子代理在隔离的 git worktree 里各跑一个实验，把结论记进一棵假设树，只有通过留出测试评测的改动才合并进最终版本。
howto.when: 当你要求迭代优化某个能被评测的产物（如提高模型 eval 分数、改进 agent/harness、调优 pipeline）时触发。即使你没提 Arbor 或假设树，只要描述反复实验加评测的循环也会触发。

say.text: 把这个 repo 的 eval 分数提上去，别只记住 dev 集
say.note: 先确认目标和 dev/test 评测器再开跑

say.text: 用 arbor 帮我改进这个 agent harness，跑 12 轮实验
say.note: 按给定预算跑协调循环

say.text: 帮我在这条数据 pipeline 上搜索几种做法，保留通过测试评测的版本
say.note: 只有通过测试评测的改动才成为新最好版本

howto.what_en: Claude autonomously improves an existing artifact against an objective: it forms hypotheses, tests each via subagents in isolated git worktrees, keeps a hypothesis tree, and merges only changes that pass a held-out test evaluator.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to iteratively optimize a scoreable artifact (eval score, agent/harness, pipeline), even without the word "Arbor", when you describe repeated experiment-and-evaluate loops.

say_en.text: Raise this repo's eval score — and don't just memorize the dev set.
say_en.note: Confirms objective and dev/test evaluators first.

say_en.text: Use arbor to improve this agent harness, run 12 experiment cycles.
say_en.note: Runs the coordinator loop for the given budget.

say_en.text: Search over approaches for this data pipeline and keep whatever passes test.
say_en.note: Only test-passing changes get merged as the new best.
